module: Auxiliary controller for central tire inflation/deflation (CTIS, off-road/military vehicles). Wheels are grouped into "groups" (axles, sides...); the driver enables/disables groups, then starts inflation, deflation or stop for all active groups. The controller directly modifies the pressure of the wheel pressure groups (obj:setGroupPressure), equalizes pressures within a group and publishes the average pressure of the active groups and the active state of each group in electrics. Registers a "Tire pressure control" radial menu.
notes: jbeam keys read in initSecondStage: mode ("manualControl", the only supported mode), inflateMaxFlow (10) and deflateMaxFlow (10) (pressure change per second, unit of obj:getGroupPressure, Pa), activeGroupPressureElectricsName (<name>_activeGroupPressure), wheelGroups (header table: groupName, uiName, uiIcon, wheelNames, maxPressure, minPressure, groupEqualizeFlowLimit; all required except uiIcon).
Published electrics: <name>_activeGroupPressure (smoothed average pressure of the active groups, absolute Pa) and <name>_<group>_isActive (1 or 0).
Pressure never drops below obj:getEnvPressure(). A broken wheel is ignored in the average and in the equalization.
The minPressure/maxPressure limits are absolute: inflating (resp. deflating) a wheel stops at maxPressure (resp. minPressure) but equalization continues.
Groups are inactive after reset; unknown groups give a log E in setGroupState/toggleGroupState.
init does nothing: all initialization is in initSecondStage (called after the init of all controllers, because it reads wheels.*).
reset sets currentPressure to 0 for all wheels until the next read in updateGFX.
The radial menu is registered only once per VM (hasRegisteredQuickAccess); it uses controller.getControllerSafe(M.name).

initSecondStage.desc: Builds the wheel groups, reads flows and pressure limits and registers the radial menu. Called after the init of the other controllers.

reset.desc: Disables all groups, stops pressure changes and resets the electric smoother to zero.

updateGFX.desc: Every frame: reads the pressures, equalizes between wheels of a group, applies inflation/deflation to the active groups and publishes the electrics.

setGroupState.desc: Enables or disables a wheel group and displays a message. An unknown group name logs an error and does nothing.

toggleGroupState.desc: Toggles the activation of a wheel group.

startInflateActiveGroups.desc: Starts inflation (change = +inflateMaxFlow per second) of the active groups and displays a message.

startDeflateActiveGroups.desc: Starts deflation (change = -deflateMaxFlow per second) of the active groups and displays a message.

stopActiveGroups.desc: Stops the current inflation/deflation and displays a message.

getState.desc: Saveable state: active pressure change, active state of each group and pressure of each wheel (keys prefixed by the controller name).

setState.desc: Restores activations, pressure change and wheel pressures (clamped between ambient pressure and maxPressure, broken wheels ignored).
